verdict.rationale: Query auditing is documented: every agent query is logged in full and can be replayed down to the columns it read (docs-14). The full stock ClickHouse observability surface is available cluster-wide (docs-20), with drill-down to individual executions (docs-32). However, column-level access logging is not lineage, and nothing documents tracing where data came from through transformations. missing for 10: column-level data lineage/provenance, explicit user-identity attribution in audit logs for non-agent queries, audit log retention/export details, independent corroboration.
